:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-oinf-at-mle}

Evaluated at $\hat\pmean_{ML} = \rvarbar$:

$$
\ba
\oinf(\hat\pmean_{ML}; \vx)
&= \frac{2n\rvarbar}{\rvarbar^3} - \frac{n}{\rvarbar^2}
&& \text{(observed information at $\pmean = \rvarbar$)}
\\
&= \frac{2n}{\rvarbar^2} - \frac{n}{\rvarbar^2}
&& \text{(cancel one factor of $\rvarbar$)}
\\
&= \frac{n}{\rvarbar^2}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}
\ea
$$

So $\SE{\hat\pmean_{ML}} \approx \sqrt{\oinf(\hat\pmean_{ML}; \vx)^{-1}} = \frac{\rvarbar}{\sqrt{n}}$.

:::
